integrity: A complete symbolic integral filtered-chain splitting is provided. A standalone finite checker corroborates 205 weight tuples; finite checks are not a substitute for the uniform proof. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Determines reduced integral homology persistence for degrees at least zero, but not fixed-space homotopy, multiplicative structures, or quotient topology. Normalizer equivariance of the indicated basis is asserted only for a unique smallest orbit. An unindexed generic weighted-simplex persistence equivalence remains possible.
title: Integral fixed-point persistence of uniform-matroid rank filtrations
